en_title: Insomniac Clears the Air After Marvel's Wolverine Fans Confuse Lady Deathstrike for Psylocke
cn_title: 《漫威金刚狼》角色认错，开发商澄清
subtitle: 原来不是灵蝶
opus_summary: Insomniac澄清《漫威金刚狼》预告中的持剑者是死亡女，并非玩家误认的灵蝶。游戏将于2026年9月15日登陆PS5，琴·葛蕾和剑齿虎确认登场。

paragraphs.en: Insomniac Games has cleared the air after a new trailer for Marvel's Wolverine had fans confusing Lady Deathstrike for Psylocke.
paragraphs.cn: Insomniac出面澄清，此前《漫威金刚狼》新预告片让玩家把死亡女误认成了灵蝶。

paragraphs.en: If you thought the launch trailer for the PlayStation 5-exclusive video game would come and go without controversy, I've got bad news. Despite coming in at a little less than a minute and a half long, Marvel's Wolverine managed to kick up a storm of confusion online after fans spotted what they believed was a new character wielding a familiar-looking purple energy sword.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你以为这款PS5独占游戏的发售预告片能平静发布、不引发争议，那我得告诉你，事情并非如此。尽管预告片时长不到1分30秒，《漫威金刚狼》还是因为玩家发现了一名他们认为是新角色的人物，并且对方手持一把看起来颇为熟悉的紫色能量剑，在网上掀起了一场混乱。

paragraphs.en: In comments across YouTube, Instagram, X/Twitter, and other social media platforms, you don't have to look too hard to find watchers questioning if the sneering villain featured in the launch trailer was Psylocke. Psylocke is an energy-wielding mutant who's been known to show up across various X-Men stories in the past, so when a glowing sword showed up in Marvel's Wolverine, many believed it to be a grand character reveal.
paragraphs.cn: 在YouTube、Instagram、X等社交媒体平台的评论区，不难看到有人质疑发售预告片中的那个狰狞反派是不是灵蝶。灵蝶是一名能够操纵能量的变种人，过去曾在多部《X战警》相关故事中登场。因此，当《漫威金刚狼》中出现一把发光的剑时，许多人都以为这是一次重磅角色公布。

paragraphs.en: Well, it's not, and Insomniac has done its best to make that clear.
paragraphs.cn: 但事实并非如此，Insomniac也尽力澄清了这一点。

paragraphs.en: The post above was published earlier today and labels the sword user as Lady Deathstrike. The PlayStation developer didn't outright say it's trying to quiet the noise that's emerged in the days following the trailer's reveal, but judging by the comments, many are shocked any clarification was needed in the first place.
paragraphs.cn: 上述帖子于今天早些时候发布，并将持剑者标注为死亡女。这家PlayStation开发商没有直说自己是在试图平息预告片公开后几天里出现的风波，但从评论来看，许多人对居然需要这番澄清感到震惊。

paragraphs.en: "The fact it has to be stated is so crazy to me," one user said . "Larp monsters are everywhere."
paragraphs.cn: 「这居然还需要专门说明，真是太离谱了。」一位用户说道。「到处都是LARP怪物。」

paragraphs.en: "No that’s Psylocke, some guy told me and he’s for sure right," another user joked .
paragraphs.cn: 「不，那就是灵蝶，有个家伙告诉我的，而且他肯定没错。」另一位用户开玩笑道。

paragraphs.en: It really does seem to be the purple sword that's to blame here because, as some have noted, Lady Deathstrike looks nothing like Psylocke. The version of the character featured in Marvel's Wolverine doesn't exactly have a comic-accurate design, but her vest and hair do more to link her to Lady Deathstrike than the character many were making her out to be.
paragraphs.cn: 看来，问题确实出在那把紫色的剑上。正如一些人指出的那样，死亡女的外形和灵蝶完全不像。《漫威金刚狼》中的这个版本并不完全还原漫画形象，但她的背心和发型反而更容易让人联想到死亡女，而不是众人误认的灵蝶。

paragraphs.en: There's also the fact that Insomniac has talked about Lady Deathstrike being in Marvel's Wolverine before, with the launch trailer also being far from the first time we've even seen her in the game. For example, one early look at her new design arrived in July's Ain't No Hero trailer , while a GIF the studio posted on social media showed her looking down on viewers.
paragraphs.cn: 此外，Insomniac此前就曾谈到死亡女会出现在《漫威金刚狼》中，而这部发售预告片也绝不是我们第一次在游戏中看到她。例如，7月发布的《Ain't No Hero》预告片中就曾展示过她的新设计；工作室在社交媒体上发布的一张GIF也曾显示她俯视着观众。

paragraphs.en: These aren't clips of her doing anything you'd expect Psylocke to do either. This version has been shown attacking Logan with Lady Deathstrike's instantly recognizable finger claws on full display multiple times. Why she's using that sword or where it came from remains a mystery, but whatever the reason, it's not because she's actually Psylocke. That's not to say that character isn't in the game at all; other X-Men regulars like Jean Grey and Sabretooth are confirmed to make an apperance. If Psylockie is in the game, though, Insomniac hasn't publicly said a thing about her.
paragraphs.cn: 这些片段中的她也没有做出任何你会期待灵蝶做的事。这个版本的角色曾多次亮出死亡女那对一眼就能认出的指尖利爪，向金刚狼发起攻击。她为什么会使用那把剑，或者那把剑从何而来，仍然是个谜。但无论原因是什么，都不是因为她其实是灵蝶。这并不代表游戏中完全没有灵蝶；琴·葛蕾和剑齿虎等《X战警》常驻角色已经确认会登场。不过，如果灵蝶确实会出现在游戏中，Insomniac目前没有公开透露任何相关信息。

paragraphs.en: Logan will at least take on Lady Deathstrike – not Psylocke – when Marvel's Wolverine launches for PS5 September 15, 2026. Meanwhile, the launch trailer actually arrived as part of a recent State of Play presentation from Sony, which you can catch up on here . For more, you can check out IGN's last full preview and our breakdown for the game's many, many suits .
paragraphs.cn: 玩家至少会在《漫威金刚狼》于2026年9月15日登陆PS5时，与死亡女而非灵蝶交手。与此同时，这部发售预告片其实是索尼近期State of Play发布会的一部分。
